s.note: Aunt May asking Peter to pick up eggs on the way home
s.how: Whisk 8 eggs with 100ml milk, 100g grated cheddar, sliced spring onion and diced ham. Pour into a greased 12-hole muffin tin and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until puffed and set. Serve warm to someone who came home late again.

s.note: after-school snacks for a science kid
s.how: Spread 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry with 4 tbsp pizza sauce, leaving a 1cm border. Scatter with 100g sliced pepperoni, 150g grated mozzarella and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes, then cut into 2cm slices. Lay cut side up on lined trays, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until golden. Serve with 250ml warmed passata.

m.note: the dinner where Peter meets Gwen's dad
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg brisket, then soften 3 sliced onions. Add 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock and 2 tbsp tomato paste and braise covered at 160C for 3.5 hours. Roast 6 carrots for the last 40 minutes and slice the meat across the grain.

w.how: Beat 120g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 150ml milk and vanilla, then 300g self-raising flour. Spoon 12 rounds onto trays and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Ice half of each with white icing and half with icing mixed with 2 tbsp cocoa.

d.n: Gwen's dark hot chocolate with marshmallow
d.how: Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Take off the heat and whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 1 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 mugs. Top each with 3 large marshmallows and toast them with a kitchen blowtorch or under a hot grill for 30 seconds.
